0221110100122200002021 - ASI: 18

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  200 = 2 * 00
  202 = 2 * 02
  1001 = 10 * 01
  2211 = 22 * 11
  00202 = 00 * 202
  02211 = 0 * 2211
  22200 = 22 * 200
  002021 = 00202 * 1
  101001 = 10 * 1001
  02211101001 = 02211 * 101001
  22200002021 = 22200 * 002021
  0221110100122200002021 = 02211101001 * 22200002021
